tools.name: command_run
tools.description: Run a bounded diagnostic or maintenance command inside the declared runtime.

tools.name: service_status
tools.description: Read the live service or database health signal.

tools.name: business_probe
tools.description: Check the declared public business operation, not just process liveness.

tools.name: signal_view
tools.description: Read bounded live signals declared for this operational scenario.

tools.name: service_control
tools.description: Apply one bounded change selected from live diagnostic evidence. Preserve the service contract and do not bypass validation.

action.description: A bounded operation label inferred from the observed live state.

constraints: Do not read case root, evaluator files, hidden labels, scenario files, host credentials, or Docker sockets.
Tool calls and outputs are recorded in the writable trace directory.
